title: Sleepy - Smart Voice Assistant
description:
Built a Windows desktop productivity application that helps users stay focused while watching videos by monitoring inactivity and interacting with the user through voice and audio notifications.

Key Features:

• Automatic inactivity detection and configurable sleep timer
• Voice-based “Are you awake?” interaction with speech recognition
• Automatically pauses videos when the user becomes inactive
• Resumes playback only after confirming the user is awake
• Audio notifications with configurable volume control
• Configurable timers, detection behavior, and application settings
• Modular Python architecture designed for reliable background operation

title: AlHaset Job Talent Platform
description:
Built a full-stack platform connecting creative professionals with jobs, projects, and hiring opportunities. The platform includes job discovery and applications, a public talent marketplace, photography requests, and automated email alerts for relevant opportunities.

Key Features:

• Role-based authentication and authorization (talents, employers, admins)
• Job search with filtering, pagination, categories, and Last Minute opportunities
• Public talent marketplace for discovering creative professionals
• Job application and management workflows
• Photography request and offer system for clients and photographers
• Automated email alerts for relevant jobs and opportunities
• Admin dashboard for managing users, jobs, requests, and platform activity
• RESTful Spring Boot API with MongoDB and Redis caching
• GitHub Actions CI pipeline with automated API tests

title: Employee Management System
description:
Developed a full-stack employee management system in ASP.NET Core 8 with a clean layered architecture for scalable, maintainable CRUD workflows across employees and departments.

Key Features:

• CRUD for employees and departments with validation and relationship handling
• Search, filtering, sorting, and pagination for large datasets
• Dashboard-style insights and statistics
• Responsive UI with Bootstrap and FontAwesome
• Production-ready plumbing: EF Core, Serilog logging, Dockerized deployment

title: Accessify
description:
Developed Accessify V2 — a modular web accessibility toolbar supporting WCAG 2.1 AA and Israeli Standard 5568. Drop-in client-side toolkit that lets users customize readability and navigation without changing the host site’s code. Supports RTL (e.g. Hebrew) and multiple languages.

Key Features:

• Text size control (80%–200%)
• Contrast modes (Normal / High / Dark)
• Spacing and dyslexia-friendly font options
• Link highlighting and enhanced cursor focus circle
• Color adjustments (grayscale, sepia, invert)
• Multilingual UI with optional sync to page language/dir
• Settings persisted in localStorage; show/hide tools per control

Technical Highlights:

• ToolbarV2 API with configurable availableControls and syncWithPageLanguage
• Distributed via npm and CDN (jsDelivr); TypeScript types included
• Built with Rollup; Jest test suite including a11y-focused tests
• Lightweight overlay with minimal impact on page load

title: Portfolio Website
description:
Developed a modern, responsive portfolio website using React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, designed to showcase projects and technical skills with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.

Key Features:

• Dark/light mode with persistent user preferences
• Fully responsive, mobile-first design across all screen sizes
• Smooth scrolling navigation with subtle animations and transitions
• Lazy loading for images and sections to improve performance
• SEO optimization including meta tags, Open Graph, and social sharing support
• Accessible design using semantic HTML and ARIA attributes

Technical Highlights:

• Built with React 18 and optimized using Vite for fast load times
• Styled with Tailwind CSS for scalable and maintainable UI development
• Deployed via GitHub Pages with automated build configuration
• Focused on performance optimization and clean component structure

title: Appium Login With Python
description: This project demonstrates automated testing of a login functionality using Appium and Selenium. The tests are designed to run on an Android device using the Chrome browser
